encoding.BCR: Standard piecewise linear-to-sRGB encoding of source albedo into RGB; roughness copied directly to alpha as a candidate convention
encoding.NMO: Linear channels: flat normal X/Y encoded as 128/255, metalness in B, occlusion 255 in A
encoding.import: TIFFResourceClass PC; ColorHQCompression; explicit ToSRGB for BCR and ToLinear for NMO; generated mipmaps
encoding.quantization: Clamp to [0,1], multiply by 255 and round to nearest with floor(x+0.5)
encoding.limitation: No calibrated BRDF/roughness or photometric equivalence to Cycles is asserted

case_changes.orientation: Original color constants on other materials; neutral uses a repeated asymmetric color pattern in BCR and flat dielectric NMO
case_changes.packed: All seven materials use original candidate BCR/NMO constants; Color multiplier white
case_changes.metal-matte: Same as packed except intended metal material BCR alpha encodes roughness 0.85 instead of 0.15
case_changes.metal-dielectric: Same as packed except intended metal material NMO B channel is 0 instead of 255

plan.orientation_pattern: Each 128x128 tile: top-left red, top-right green, bottom-left blue, bottom-right yellow; 8px white L along top and left tile edges. Pixel origin is image top-left.
plan.orientation_probe_coordinates: Enfusion local [x,height,z]; back wall front surface; project using verified camera and compare with TXO face UVs. No fitted screen alignment.
plan.response_acceptance: Report pixel changes in the preselected intended-metal sphere region and inspect full images; any change alone does not establish physical BRDF correctness

No renderer-buffer interface
Outdoor illumination is not the reference area light

orientation.method: Predeclared world points; affine UV interpolation from original TXO corners; analytic camera projection without image alignment; mean hue in fixed 5x5 image patches
orientation.analysis_selection: Points and asymmetric pattern declared before capture. Hue classification thresholds/patch size implemented after visual inspection; this is a diagnostic, not a held-out fidelity gate.
limits: Only four back-wall points under one camera; other faces, mip transitions and normal maps require separate checks
Hue agreement does not establish photometric equivalence, compiled-pixel equality or neural integration

scope: Original material/texture response in one native room/camera; no model processing.
limits: One capture per case; no estimate of repeat variation or motion stability in this batch
Header format is checked; Enfusion payload is not independently decoded
Roughness alpha is a candidate direct encoding, not a calibrated Cycles BRDF match
The shiny sphere reflects surrounding scenery; environment/reflection control remains open
Four back-wall orientation samples do not validate all surfaces, mips or tangent-space normals
Earlier strict TXO precision failures remain failed
No matched reference, live model, scene buffers or complete-frame performance proof
next: Control surrounding light/reflections and establish exposure/color mapping before an engine/reference lighting pair.
